title: [review] lichend.rs: Concentrator reset/configure errors ignored
description: Both `conc.reset().await` and `conc.configure(...)` results are discarded. If hardware initialization fails, the concentrator enters an undefined state. Subsequent receive/transmit calls may silently fail or produce corrupted data, with no indication to the operator.
close_reason: Fixed: Concentrator reset/configure errors now handled with early return on failure. If hardware initialization fails, HAT mode aborts with error log instead of entering undefined state.
